# LogSplitterLab

> Research-based log splitter comparisons for homeowners and rural property owners. Specifications are sourced from manufacturer and retailer documentation and cited on every product page; the site does not currently conduct hands-on product testing and labels its reviews accordingly.

## Product Reviews

- [Log Splitter Reviews — Verified Specifications](https://logsplitterlab.com/reviews/): Specification-based log splitter research summaries for gas and electric models, sourced from manufacturer and retailer listings.
- [Log Splitter Brands](https://logsplitterlab.com/brands/): Browse every log splitter brand in our verified catalog by model, tonnage, and power source.
- [YARDMAX YS0650 6.5-Ton Electric Log Splitter (YS0650) Review](https://logsplitterlab.com/reviews/yardmax-ys0650/): YARDMAX YS0650: verified 6.5-ton electric log splitter specifications, strengths, limitations, and who it fits — sourced from manufacturer and retailer listings.
- [SuperHandy 20-Ton Rapid Auto Return Gas Log Splitter (GUO077) Review](https://logsplitterlab.com/reviews/superhandy-20-ton/): SuperHandy GUO077: verified 20-ton gas log splitter specifications, strengths, limitations, and who it fits — sourced from manufacturer and retailer listings.
- [Landworks 20-Ton Portable Gas Log Splitter (GUO079) Review](https://logsplitterlab.com/reviews/landworks-guo079/): Landworks GUO079: verified 20-ton gas log splitter specifications, strengths, limitations, and who it fits — sourced from manufacturer and retailer listings.
- [YARDMAX 32-Ton Gas Log Splitter (YU3266) Review](https://logsplitterlab.com/reviews/yardmax-32-ton-cr950/): YARDMAX YU3266: verified 32-ton gas log splitter specifications, strengths, limitations, and who it fits — sourced from manufacturer and retailer listings.

## Comparisons & Buying Advice

- [Log Splitter Comparisons](https://logsplitterlab.com/comparisons/): Log splitter comparisons and best-of roundups — gas vs. electric, best electric models, best gas models, and how to size a splitter — to help you choose before you shop by model.
- [Gas vs. Electric Log Splitter: The Real Difference](https://logsplitterlab.com/comparisons/gas-vs-electric-log-splitter/): A category-by-category comparison of gas and electric log splitters: power, portability, noise, maintenance, cold-weather behavior, and who should choose each.
- [Best Electric Log Splitters for Homeowners](https://logsplitterlab.com/best-electric-log-splitters/): Verified electric log splitters compared by tonnage, cycle time, log capacity, and electrical requirements — specification-based research, not physical testing.
- [Best Gas Log Splitters for Homeowners and Rural Properties](https://logsplitterlab.com/best-gas-log-splitters/): Verified gas log splitters compared by tonnage, cycle time, log capacity, and horizontal/vertical operation — specification-based research, not physical testing.
- [What Size Log Splitter Do I Need?](https://logsplitterlab.com/what-size-log-splitter-do-i-need/): Why tonnage alone doesn't determine the right log splitter size — wood species, moisture, diameter, knots, grain, and volume all matter. Includes example buyer profiles.

## Guides

- [Log Splitter Buying Guide](https://logsplitterlab.com/buying-guide/): A complete log splitter buying guide covering power sources, tonnage, log diameter, cycle time, safety, and a buying checklist for homeowners.
- [Log Splitter Maintenance Guide](https://logsplitterlab.com/maintenance/): General log splitter maintenance concepts: pre-use inspection, hydraulic fluid, engine and cord checks, storage, and warning signs that need professional service.
